items.title: Adrian Cunningham interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 31, 2021
items.q: Rachel Domber, who is the head of Arbors, she is really supportive. She has been an amazing patron, not just to me but to music in general.

ctx.x: Back to this record for a moment, I was glad to see that, of course you were able to play with some really wonderful people here, but also that you had at least half the tunes were your own compositions. And from what I’ve learned a lot of times producers and so forth say well not too much of your own stuff right away, you need to play — people are going to read, “Oh yeah I like that song, I like that song, I’ll buy it.” So how did that happen?

Well that album was more the result of the musicians that I was working with. So I think I mean that’s going back five, six years now so I can’t remember the exact — I think what happened was I played with Jeff and John at the Vail Jazz Festival. I think we did a set together. And I mean I’ve grown up loving them but you know it was such an amazing experience. So the record that you’re showing, the camera is Arbors Records. And Arbors, the album “Jazz Speak,” the one we’re talking about, that was my second one.…
